notes.title: Demo version of LetsGal out now
notes.notes:
Just now, we released the long-awaited demo version of "LetsGal: A Love Story in Development"!

This game is an all-ages, male-oriented Galgame centered on "pure love" and girls & romance. The story follows your journey in Tokyo as you strive to "create the best Galgame" while navigating romantic relationships with 8 distinctive heroines.

This demo features a time lock set at approximately 1/6th of the total game length, concluding at the end of Spring Day 30 (Night) in Year 1.

The demo includes:

All 8 heroines (4 primary launch heroines and 4 secondary heroines).

Several supporting characters.

13 main story events.

8 affection events.

264 daily events.

720,000 words of game text.

This content represents less than 30% of the planned full game. However, due to the time lock, some events requiring specific prerequisites may not trigger during this demo.

Please note: This demo is still under testing and may contain bugs and unbalanced game mechanics. We sincerely appreciate any feedback to help us improve!

Currently Unavailable in Demo (Will be added later to this demo):

Mini-games and features like "Ema" (votive tablets), "Fishing," "Game Weekly Reports," and others.

Target Release: The full version is planned for release by the end of this year, barring any unforeseen review-related delays.

We eagerly invite all players who try the demo to share their feedback and suggestions! Your input is invaluable for enhancing the final release.

Thank you so much for downloading and playing! We truly hope you enjoy it, even if just a little.
